key_figures.why: show geometric path construction, scene representation, objective tradeoff and selected routes
key_figures.supports: internal mechanism illustration and author-reported tradeoff/association
key_figures.cannot_prove: perceptual validity, global Pareto optimality, or constraint satisfaction unless tied to independent ratings/reference fronts/final path registry

key_figures.why: expose components behind constructed illusion score
key_figures.supports: within-dataset score decomposition and descriptor relationships
key_figures.cannot_prove: objective psychological illusion quality or external ranking validity because calibration and evaluation share the same garden set/anchor

key_figures.why: show pairwise concentration, feature stability and exploratory grouping
key_figures.supports: descriptive structure under the chosen 179D representation
key_figures.cannot_prove: true cultural universality, discriminative generalization, or statistically independent cluster significance

figure_decision_rules: Pareto plots must show objective orientation, feasible set/constraint status and reference-point/front provenance when HV/GD are quoted
constructed-score ranking figures need an external or held-out validation layer, not only agreement with a forced anchor
correlation heatmaps with |r|~1 should trigger redundancy/double-counting review
cluster/dendrogram plots are exploratory at n=10/11; stability or external labels are required before confirmatory claims
similarity heatmaps where every pair is high should be paired with null/permutation or discriminative reference distributions to detect concentration
